title: Not the Topper, but a Dreamer

shots.image: the same stack of schoolbooks in morning light, {GIRL11} picking them up, close view
shots.motion: morning light grows, she lifts the books
shots.sfx: morning birds, books being picked up, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I was never the class topper.

shots.image: {AMMI} braiding {GIRL11}'s hair with red ribbons in the courtyard of {HOME} before school, seen from behind
shots.motion: the mother ties the ribbon, the girl adjusts her school bag
shots.sfx: fabric rustle, birds, kitchen sounds, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I was an ordinary student, learning at my own pace, completing homework and preparing for examinations.

shots.image: {GIRL11} and {FRIEND_SCHOOL} walking to school along a tree-lined street with a cycle rickshaw, seen from behind
shots.motion: they walk swinging their bags, tracking shot
shots.sfx: footsteps, bicycle bell, birds, distant traffic, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Sometimes I did well, and sometimes I struggled.

shots.image: a 1990s Indian classroom with wooden desks, a blackboard and ceiling fans, {SCHOOL_TEACHER} at the front, {GIRL11} at her desk seen from behind
shots.sfx: classroom murmur, chalk on blackboard, no music

shots.image: {GIRL11} standing at her desk holding up her notebook, seen from the side
shots.sfx: pages rustling, quiet classroom, no music

lines.speaker: GIRL
lines.text: Yes, ma'am. I've tried all the questions.

shots.image: {GIRL11} looking out of the classroom window at clouds and birds, daydreaming, side view
shots.motion: clouds drift, a bird lands on the window grill
shots.sfx: birds, distant classroom voices, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: But I always had an imagination of my own.

shots.image: a school playground with a big neem tree, {FRIEND_SCHOOL} running ahead and waving back to {GIRL11}
shots.motion: the friend runs, the girl hurries after her
shots.sfx: school bell, children laughing, running footsteps, no music

lines.speaker: FRIEND_CHILD
lines.text: Come on! Let's go and play.

shots.image: {GIRL11} doing homework at a small wooden desk at home in the evening under a table lamp, seen from behind
shots.motion: her pencil writes, she pauses and looks up thoughtfully
shots.sfx: pencil writing, pages turning, crickets, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I used to wonder what I would become when I grew up.

shots.image: {GIRL11} on the rooftop of {HOME} at sunset looking at the sky, kites far away, seen from behind
shots.motion: her plaits move in the breeze, slow push-in
shots.sfx: wind, distant birds, evening ambience, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I didn't have all the answers, but I had dreams.

shots.image: {GIRL11} placing her schoolbooks on a table next to a college admission booklet, looking at it curiously, close side view
shots.motion: she slides the booklet towards her, camera moves onto it
shots.sfx: books placed down, page turning, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And those dreams quietly stayed with me.
